sourceCautions.note: Re-derive metric definitions: Pearson correlation across predictions and labels can be negative; do not use the printed 0-to-1 description as its general range.
Reconcile the printed low-rank matrix dimensions with r*(d_in+d_out) before reusing parameter-count examples. Use consistently named A/B matrices and declared shapes.
Support-weighted F1 does not generally give equal influence to minority classes. Macro-F1 weights class F1 scores equally; values can coincide on a balanced test set.
Distinguish GGUF container from tensor precision. The text says eight-bit while the following FP16 filename denotes sixteen-bit; E5 verifies its actual pinned Q8 artifact metadata instead.
